name: Claims Adjudication Assistant Agent
description: Claims Adjudication Assistant Agent — a governed Pause fabric agent (agentforce, A2A). Governance tier: payer-operations. Enforces 4 Pause Agent Fabric policies. Prototype agent card — synthetic data, no real PHI.

skills.name: Applies payer-specific first-pass claim edits (NCCI-PTP u...
skills.description: Applies payer-specific first-pass claim edits (NCCI-PTP unbundling, LCD/NCD coverage, benefit-limit exhaustion, prior-auth missing, duplicate submission, out-of-network, timely-filing) and classifies each claim as clean-pay / pend-clinical-review / pend-adjudicator-review / deny-drafted with a specific catalog reason code — a first-pass payer-side adjudicator, distinct from Prior Auth (pre-service), Member Service (billing self-service), and Grievance & Appeals (post-denial intake)

skills.name: Adjudication is DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the cl...
skills.description: Adjudication is DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the claim + member benefits + edit catalog + caller-provided asOfDate (no randomness, no clock); the same context always yields the same decision + applied edits + reason code, with a documented decision precedence (deny > pend-clinical > pend-adjudicator > clean-pay) and stable edit-id ordering

skills.name: Every applied edit must trace to the defined CLAIM_EDIT_C...
skills.description: Every applied edit must trace to the defined CLAIM_EDIT_CATALOG — an off-catalog / fabricated edit is blocked at the Agent Fabric governance boundary (policy.claims.edit-catalog-sourced), so the agent cannot invent a bespoke 'you owe us more' edit

skills.name: The agent NEVER autonomously finalizes a denial — every d...
skills.description: The agent NEVER autonomously finalizes a denial — every denial is DRAFTED for adjudicator cosign (requiresAdjudicatorCosign:true, cosigned:false), and any autonomous denial is blocked (policy.claims.no-autonomous-denial); denial letters are legally consequential under CMS / ERISA / state insurance code and must have a human sign-off. Mirrors the PA Agent's no-autonomous-submission, the HEDIS Agent's no-autonomous-submission, and the CCM Agent's no-autonomous-billing posture

skills.name: Every non-clean-pay decision must cite a specific catalog...
skills.description: Every non-clean-pay decision must cite a specific catalog reason code (CLAIM_REASON_CODE_CATALOG — illustrative CO-97 / CO-50 / CO-96 / CO-119 / CO-197 / CO-18 / CO-242 / CO-29 style) — a denial or pend without a stated reason code is blocked (policy.claims.reason-code-integrity); under Section 1557 / state insurance code / CMS, a denial notice must state the specific reason

skills.name: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic edit catalog + reason...
skills.description: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic edit catalog + reason-code catalog + benefit-rule shape — clearly labeled; NOT CMS X12 837 claim spec, an NCCI PTP edit table, an LCD/NCD medical-necessity registry, or a real payer's benefit configuration
